description: This file defines functions and types related to transform handles for elements in a drawing application, including handle generation, resizing logic, and bounding box detection.

methods.name: generateTransformHandle
methods.description: Generates a transform handle position based on element coordinates, rotation, and center point.

methods.name: canResizeFromSides
methods.description: Determines if an element can be resized from sides based on the editor interface, especially for mobile devices.

methods.name: getOmitSidesForEditorInterface
methods.description: Returns which sides should be omitted for resize handles based on the editor interface configuration.

methods.name: getTransformHandlesFromCoords
methods.description: Calculates transform handle positions around an element based on coordinates, rotation, zoom, and pointer type.

methods.name: getTransformHandles
methods.description: Gets transform handles for a specific element, considering its type, state, and zoom level.

methods.name: hasBoundingBox
methods.description: Checks if a set of elements has a bounding box for selection or resize purposes, considering app state and device type.
